components.name: Button
components.description: A highly customizable Cyberpunk-themed button with neon effects and animations.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style of the button.

- `secondary`: Alternative action, bordered.
- `danger`: Destructive action, red glow.

props.name: size

props.name: children

props.name: variant

props.name: size

props.name: label

props.name: helperText

props.name: error

props.name: leftIcon

props.name: rightIcon

props.description: Optional label text to display next to the toggle

props.name: variant

components.name: Select

props.name: label
props.description: Label for the select field

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the select input.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant.

props.name: options
props.description: List of options to choose from

props.name: placeholder

props.name: helperText

Convenience callback that receives the selected string value directly.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message to display below the checkbox.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: onCheckedChange

Convenience callback that receives the boolean checked value directly.

components.name: FormField
components.description:
A cyberpunk-styled wrapper that gives any form control a consistent
label, helper text, and error/success validation state — without
requiring the control itself to know about labels or messages.

Built-in CyberUI controls like `Input` and `Select` already manage their
own label/error wiring; FormField is for wrapping native elements
(`<textarea>`, a raw `<input>`) or custom/third-party controls that don't.
components.docSummary: Label/helper/error/success wrapper for any form control.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text rendered above the field.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text shown below the field. Overridden by `error` or `success` when set.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Takes priority over `success` and `helperText` (in that order) when more than one is set, sets validation state to `'error'`, and marks the field `aria-invalid`.

props.name: success
props.description: Success message. Overrides `helperText`, but is itself overridden by `error` when both are set.

props.name: required
props.description:
Marks the field as required — appends a `*` indicator to the label (only
rendered when `label` is also set) and sets `aria-required` on the child
control.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables the field — dims the label/message and sets `disabled` on the
child control. The control ends up disabled if either this prop or the
child's own `disabled` prop is true.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size of the label and helper/error/success message. Supports responsive values.

props.name: children
props.description:
The form control this field wraps — a single React element that accepts
`id`, `disabled`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required`, and `aria-describedby`
(native form elements, or a custom control that forwards them).

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the child control and referenced by the label's `htmlFor`. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name for the outer wrapper.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description:
A cyberpunk-styled radio group for mutually-exclusive single-choice
selection, matching Checkbox's neon SVG icon treatment. Supports both
controlled and uncontrolled modes, and arrow-key navigation between
options via a roving tabindex.
components.docSummary: Neon-styled radio group for mutually-exclusive selection. Arrow-key navigation via roving tabindex.

props.name: options
props.description: Options to render, in order.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled selected value. When set, RadioGroup stops managing its own
selection state and `onValueChange` becomes the only way to react to
option changes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial selected value for uncontrolled usage. Ignored when `value` is
provided.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fired with the newly selected option's value whenever selection changes.

props.name: name
props.description:
Name for the underlying native `<input type="radio">` group. Auto-generated
when omitted — pass an explicit name if this RadioGroup is submitted
inside a native `<form>` and the field name matters server-side.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label, rendered as a `<legend>` above the options.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message to display below the options.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of each radio dot and its label. Supports responsive values.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction of the options. Supports responsive values.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every option in the group.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer `<fieldset>`.

props.name: id
props.description: Optional id override for the group's `<fieldset>` element.

components.name: Card
components.description: A cyberpunk-themed container with glassmorphism, neon borders, and responsive spacing.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style of the card.
- `default`: Standard glassmorphism.
- `accent`: Glowing border and hover effects.
- `small`: Compact padding for tight spaces.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding size of the card content.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional title for the card

props.name: titleBorder
props.description: Whether to show a border under the title.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to be rendered inside the card

components.name: Modal
components.description: A cinematic Cyberpunk modal with CRT boot-up effects, RGB glow, and immersive animations.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the modal is visible.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Callback when the modal requests to close.

props.name: title
props.description: Title text shown in the modal header.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to be rendered inside the modal body.

props.name: footer
props.description:
Custom footer content. Overrides the default Cancel/Confirm action buttons
(`onCancel`/`onConfirm` and related props are ignored when `footer` is set).

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Fired when the Cancel button is clicked. Only rendered if provided.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Fired when the Confirm button is clicked. Only rendered if provided.

props.name: cancelText
props.description: Label for the Cancel button.

props.name: confirmText
props.description: Label for the Confirm button.

props.name: confirmLoading
props.description: Shows a loading state and disables the Confirm button.

props.name: showCancel
props.description: Whether to render the Cancel button (requires `onCancel`).

props.name: showConfirm
props.description: Whether to render the Confirm button (requires `onConfirm`).

props.name: size
props.description:
Width of the modal.
- sm: 448px, md: 512px, lg: 672px, xl: 896px
Use `lg` or `xl` for content-heavy modals (forms, tables, multi-step flows).

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual variant of the modal.
- `default`: Standard RGB glow border.
- `danger`: Red error glow — use for destructive confirmations.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Whether clicking the overlay backdrop closes the modal.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether pressing Escape closes the modal.

props.name: animation
props.description: CRT open/close animation timing and effects.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the modal panel.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the overlay backdrop.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Whether to render the header close (×) button.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fired when the modal begins opening (before animation completes).

props.name: onCRTBootComplete
props.description: Fired when the CRT boot animation finishes and the modal is fully visible.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style of the divider.
- `gradient`: Gradient fade from center (default).
- `solid`: Solid semi-transparent line.
- `dashed`: Dashed border style.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation of the divider.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

components.name: Accordion
components.description:
A cyberpunk-styled collapsible section list for FAQs, settings panels,
and other grouped content. Expanded panels get a neon accent border and
a rotating glyph indicator; height transitions are pure CSS (no JS
measuring).
components.docSummary: Collapsible section list. `mode`: `single` (default) or `multiple` open panels.

props.name: items
props.description: Sections to render, in order.

props.name: mode
props.description:
Whether one panel or several panels can be open at once.
- `single`: opening a panel closes any other open panel.
- `multiple`: panels open and close independently.

props.name: defaultOpenIds
props.description:
Initial open item id(s) for uncontrolled usage. Ignored when `openIds`
is provided.

props.name: openIds
props.description:
Controlled open item id(s). When set, the Accordion stops managing its
own open state and `onOpenIdsChange` becomes the only way to react to
header toggles.

props.name: onOpenIdsChange
props.description:
Fired whenever a header is toggled, with the resulting open id(s) —
a single-element (or empty) array in `single` mode, any length in
`multiple` mode.

props.name: size
props.description: Header padding and text size. Supports responsive values.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer container.

props.name: size

props.name: onClose

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A neon-bordered popover that reveals supplemental info on hover or keyboard focus.

props.name: children
props.description:
The trigger element. Must be a single React element that accepts an
`aria-describedby` attribute (native elements, `Button`, `Badge`, etc).
Wrap plain text/icons in a `<span tabIndex={0}>` so the trigger is
keyboard-focusable — the tooltip only opens on hover or focus.

props.name: content
props.description: Content rendered inside the tooltip panel.

props.name: placement
props.description: Side of the trigger the tooltip is anchored to. Supports responsive values.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style, reusing the neon palette from Button/Card.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the tooltip panel (text size + padding). Supports responsive values.

props.name: delay
props.description:
Delay in ms before the tooltip appears after hover/focus starts.
Hiding is always immediate so the panel doesn't linger.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the tooltip — the trigger renders as-is with no hover/focus behavior.

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled visibility. When set, the tooltip stops managing its own open
state and `onOpenChange` becomes the only way to react to hover/focus/Escape.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fired whenever hover, focus, blur, or Escape would change visibility.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the tooltip panel.

props.name: id
props.description: Id for the tooltip panel. Auto-generated when omitted.

components.name: CircularProgress
components.description: A beautiful circular progress indicator with neon glow and dual-tone stroke.

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress value (0-100).

props.description:
Preset container size. Sets width and height of the component automatically.

props.name: radius
props.description:
Radius of the SVG circle in SVG units (viewBox is 50×50, center at 25,25).

props.name: className
props.description: Optional custom class name

props.name: children
props.description: Optional content to render in the center of the circle

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for screen readers

components.name: SegmentedProgress

variants.description: Circular gauge — discrete arc segments arranged in a ring. Original behaviour, and the default.

props.description: Discriminant — omit or set to 'radial' for the circular gauge.

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 64px, md: 96px, lg: 128px, xl: 160px.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional content rendered in the center of the gauge.

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress value (0–100).

props.name: className
props.description: Optional custom class name.

variants.description: Linear discrete-block bar (▮▮▮▮▯▯) — health bars, step-based loading.

props.name: segments

props.name: size
props.description: Controls block height: sm h-3, md h-5, lg h-7, xl h-9.

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress value (0–100).

props.name: className
props.description: Optional custom class name.

props.name: children
props.description: Not valid in block mode.

props.name: images

props.name: currentIndex

props.name: onChange

props.name: size

props.name: interval

props.name: showArrows

props.name: showIndicators

props.name: onAfterChange

props.name: orientation

props.name: className

Visual style of the gradient.

props.name: as
props.description: The HTML element to render as.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: children

props.name: showLine

props.name: size

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: events
props.description: Array of timeline events to display.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

components.name: Avatar
components.description:
A cyberpunk-styled circular avatar for user profile images, comment threads,
and team lists. Falls back to glitch-style initials (or a custom icon) when
no image is available, and can surface a glowing online/offline/away status dot.
components.docSummary: Circular profile image with glitch-style initials fallback and an `online`/`offline`/`away` status dot.

props.name: src
props.description:
Image source URL. When omitted, or when the image fails to load,
the avatar falls back to `initials` (or initials derived from `alt`)
— or to `fallbackIcon` if no initials can be derived.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Accessible name for the avatar, and the source for auto-derived initials
(e.g. "Case Pollard" → "CP"). Required for screen reader users even
when `src` is set.

props.name: initials
props.description:
Explicit fallback initials (max 2 characters shown). Overrides initials
derived from `alt`. Useful when `alt` is a full sentence rather than a name.

props.name: fallbackIcon
props.description:
Custom fallback content rendered when there's no `src` (or it fails to
load) and no initials can be derived. Defaults to a generic operative icon.

props.name: status
props.description:
Presence indicator dot rendered on the bottom-right edge. Omit to render
no indicator at all.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the avatar circle.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional custom class name applied to the outer container.

hooks.name: useCyberScrollbar
hooks.description: Custom hook that creates a cyberpunk-themed scrollbar with animated arrows that respond to scroll velocity and direction.
hooks.docSummary: applies cyberpunk scrollbar styling to a scrollable ref.

hooks.name: useCyberNotifications
hooks.description: Access the notification context to show toast notifications. Must be used within a CyberNotificationProvider.
hooks.docSummary: `showNotification(type, title, message, options?)` toast trigger; requires `CyberNotificationProvider`.
hooks.signature: useCyberNotifications(): { showNotification: (type: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error', title: string, message: string, options?: NotificationOptions) => string }

hooks.name: useAnimatedProgress
hooks.description: A hook that oscillates a value between a min and max range. Useful for creating "breathing" or "pulse" animations.
hooks.docSummary: oscillating value generator for pulse/loading animations.
hooks.signature: useAnimatedProgress(options?: { min?: number; max?: number; speed?: number }): number

context.name: CyberNotificationProvider
context.description:
Context provider for the Cyberpunk notification system.
Wrap your application root with this provider to enable toasts.
context.docSummary: wraps the app once to enable `useCyberNotifications`.
